instruction: Follow the app's flow (using the static analysis guidance) from launch until it triggers the Accessibility Service prompt and navigates to System Accessibility Settings. Do NOT toggle a malicious service ON.

elements.text: Allow SD Maid to manage your storage.
In most cases the window will open with the correct path preselected. Entries turn green when access is granted.
Allow SD Maid to use ADB access where possible to improve results and enable features.
Each card on this screen is a permission SD Maid can use. All are optional, but more permissions mean more features and more thorough scans. Without any, most tools will find little to clean.

The accessibility service allows SD Maid to interact with your screen and automate tedious actions, e.g. tapping "Clear cache" on multiple screens.
